### 6. Storage (Tasks 4–5)

`app/storage/base.py`:
```python
ApplyFn = Callable[[Session, dict[str, WordProgress], list[AnswerEvent]], None]

class Repository(ABC):   # 39 methods, every one @abstractmethod and synchronous
    # profiles
    def list_profiles(self) -> list[Profile]              # ordered by created_at (ties: insertion order)
    def get_profile(self, profile_id: str) -> Profile | None
    def save_profile(self, p: Profile) -> None
    def delete_profile(self, profile_id: str) -> None     # cascades progress, sessions, events of that profile
    # lists
    def list_lists(self) -> list[WordList]                # ordered by created_at (ties: insertion order)
    def get_list(self, list_id: str) -> WordList | None
    def save_list(self, wl: WordList) -> None
    def delete_list(self, list_id: str) -> None           # also removes id from every profile.list_ids
    # content
    def get_content(self, band: str, word: str) -> WordContent | None
    def get_contents(self, band: str, words: list[str]) -> dict[str, WordContent]   # only words with content, request order
    def save_content(self, c: WordContent) -> None        # stores redact(c.error)
    def list_content_by_status(self, status: str) -> list[WordContent]             # by band, then word
    def list_contents(self) -> list[WordContent]          # by band, then word
    def save_draft(self, band: str, word: str, card: LearnCard, version: int) -> None   # draft + draft_version; KeyError if missing
    def swap_draft(self, band: str, word: str, version: int) -> bool
        # atomic; only if draft_version == version and draft is not None: card := draft, content_version := version,
        # draft := None, draft_version := None, status := "ready", error := ""; deletes questions with content_version
        # < version; never touches image fields/model/generated_at; False when missing
    def set_image(self, band: str, word: str, key: str | None, status: str, version: int) -> bool
        # partial update of image_key/image_status; no-op (False) unless content_version == version; bad status → ValueError
    # questions
    def get_pool(self, band: str, word: str, version: int | None = None) -> list[Question]   # None → active version; [] if no content; by created_at
    def get_pools(self, band: str, words: list[str]) -> dict[str, list[Question]]           # every requested word ([] if none)
    def add_questions(self, band: str, word: str, version: int, qs: list[Question]) -> None
        # upsert by id; ValueError if a question's band/word/content_version differ; does NOT enforce POOL_CAP
    # progress
    def get_progress(self, profile_id: str, words: list[str]) -> dict[str, WordProgress]   # only stored words, request order
    def list_progress(self, profile_id: str) -> list[WordProgress]                         # by word
    # sessions
    def save_session(self, s: Session) -> None
    def get_session(self, session_id: str) -> Session | None
    def list_sessions(self, profile_id: str, limit: int) -> list[Session]   # newest started_at first; limit <= 0 → []
    # events
    def apply_events(self, session_id: str, events: list[AnswerEvent], apply_fn: ApplyFn) -> list[str]
        # ONE transaction: load session (KeyError if missing); ValueError if any event's session_id/profile_id differ;
        # keep events whose client_event_id is not stored (duplicates in the batch applied once); load WordProgress for
        # their words (missing → WordProgress(profile_id, word)); apply_fn(session, progress_by_word, new_events);
        # insert new events, save every progress in the dict and the session; commit. Returns the deduplicated ids of
        # ALL given events in given order. Nothing new → apply_fn not called, nothing written. On any exception nothing is written.
    def list_events(self, profile_id: str, since_date: str) -> list[AnswerEvent]   # local_date >= since_date; by local_date, at
    # jobs
    def enqueue_job(self, kind: str, band: str, word: str, target_version: int, chain: list[str]) -> None
        # no-op if the existing record is pending/running with target_version >= given; otherwise upsert as pending with
        # attempts=0, last_error="", not_before="", lease_until="", lease_token="", created_at=updated_at=utc_now_iso()
        # (a running job replaced this way is no longer owned by its worker); unknown kind/band → ValueError
    def claim_next_job(self, now: str, lease_s: int) -> Job | None
        # atomic (BEGIN IMMEDIATE); candidates: (pending and not_before <= now; "" counts as due) or (running and
        # lease_until < now); order: kind != "topup" first, then created_at, then insertion; sets status running,
        # lease_until = now + lease_s, a FRESH lease_token = uuid.uuid4().hex, updated_at = now; attempts unchanged
    def get_job(self, key: str) -> Job | None
    # finish/fail/defer apply ONLY while the stored record is "running" with the same non-empty lease_token; otherwise
    # (missing key, re-enqueued by a Regenerate, or lease expired and re-claimed by another worker) nothing changes and
    # they return False. When applied: lease_until = lease_token = "", updated_at = clock.utc_now_iso(), return True.
    def finish_job(self, key: str, lease_token: str) -> bool                       # status done
    def fail_job(self, key: str, lease_token: str, error: str, retry_at: str | None) -> bool
        # attempts += 1; last_error = redact(error); retry_at → status pending + not_before = retry_at;
        # None → status failed (not_before unchanged)
    def defer_job(self, key: str, lease_token: str, not_before: str) -> bool       # status pending, not_before set, attempts unchanged
    def job_counts(self) -> dict[str, int]                # keys "pending","running","done","failed" (all present)
    # usage
    def incr_ai_calls(self, utc_date: str) -> int         # increments and returns the new count
    def get_ai_calls(self, utc_date: str) -> int
    # auth
    def incr_auth_failure(self, scope: str, ip: str, window_start: str) -> int   # key "{scope}:{ip}:{window_start}"
    def clear_auth_failures(self, scope: str, ip: str) -> None                    # every key starting "{scope}:{ip}:"
    # backup
    def export_all(self) -> dict
        # {"format": "wordquest-backup", "version": 1, "profiles": [...], "lists": [...], "contents": [...],
        #  "questions": [...], "progress": [...], "sessions": [...], "events": [...]}  (model_dump(mode="json") dicts;
        #  no jobs/auth/usage)
    def import_all(self, data: dict) -> None
        # validates format/version, that all 7 keys are lists and every record (ValueError, nothing written); replaces
        # those 7 collections atomically; deletes all jobs; duplicate primary key → ValueError("backup has conflicting
        # records: ..."); leaves ai_usage/auth_failures and blobs alone

class BlobStore(ABC):
    def put(self, key: str, data: bytes, content_type: str) -> None
    def url_for(self, key: str) -> str
    def exists(self, key: str) -> bool
    def delete(self, key: str) -> None                    # missing key is fine
```

SQLite implementation (only `app/storage/` imports `sqlite3`):
- `app/storage/sqlite_db.py`: `SCHEMA_VERSION = 1`, `CHUNK_SIZE = 500`, `SCHEMA: tuple[str, ...]`, `chunked(items, size=500)`, `placeholders(n)`; `class SqliteDB` with `__init__(self, db_path: Path)` (creates the parent dir and every table/index, `PRAGMA user_version = 1`), attribute `db_path`, `close() -> None` (closes every thread's connection), private `_conn()`, `_tx(write: bool = True)` (re-entrant; `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` / `BEGIN`; one COMMIT/ROLLBACK at the outer level), `_fetchone(sql, params)`, `_fetchall(sql, params)`. One connection per thread (`threading.local`, `check_same_thread=False` only so `close()` can close all), `isolation_level=None`, `PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL`, `busy_timeout=5000`, `foreign_keys=ON`.
- Tables (document style: indexed columns + `data TEXT` = `model_dump_json()`): `profiles(id PK, created_at, data)`, `lists(id PK, created_at, data)`, `contents(key PK, band, word, status, data)` + `idx_contents_status`, `questions(id PK, band, word, version, created_at, data)` + index(band, word, version), `progress(key PK, profile_id, word, data)` + index(profile_id), `sessions(id PK, profile_id, started_at, data)` + index(profile_id), `events(client_event_id PK, profile_id, session_id, local_date, at, data)` + index(profile_id, local_date), `jobs(key PK, kind, status, not_before, lease_until, created_at, data)` + `idx_jobs_status` (`lease_token` lives in `data`), `ai_usage(utc_date PK, count)`, `auth_failures(key PK, count)`.
- `app/storage/sqlite_catalog.py`: `content_key(band, word) -> str`; `class CatalogMixin` (profiles, lists, content, drafts, images, questions; private `_put_content(conn, c)`, `_put_question(conn, q)`).
- `app/storage/sqlite_activity.py`: `JOB_STATUSES = ("pending","running","done","failed")`, `BACKUP_FORMAT = "wordquest-backup"`, `BACKUP_VERSION = 1`, `BACKUP_COLLECTIONS = ("profiles","lists","contents","questions","progress","sessions","events")`; `class ActivityMixin` (progress, sessions, events, jobs incl. private `_update_owned_job(key, lease_token, change) -> bool`, usage, auth failures, backup).
- `app/storage/sqlite_repo.py`: `class SqliteRepository(CatalogMixin, ActivityMixin, SqliteDB, Repository)`, constructed as `SqliteRepository(db_path: Path)`; call `close()` on shutdown.

Rules per spec §8.1–8.2 with the Task 7 refinements: capacity applied before layout (`reviews + 2 * new <= C`), seeded `random.Random(seed)` (layout first, then per queue word: tier roll + choice), tier fallback, reserves from tiers 1–2 (never-seen first, then least recently seen = last index in `seen_question_ids`), `checks` always exactly 2 lists, `words` ordered by first appearance in the queue.

### 9. AI layer (Tasks 8–11)

**Names tests monkeypatch.** These modules must keep importing/defining the names below at module level and call them as module globals at call time (never bind them into a local alias or a default argument), because tests replace them with `monkeypatch.setattr(<module>, "<name>", ...)`: `app.ai.llm._sleep` (module-level `async def`), `app.ai.validate.find_blocked` (`from app.ai.safety import find_blocked`), `app.ai.content.question_batch_prompt` and `app.ai.content.check_prompt` (`from app.ai.prompts import check_prompt, learn_card_prompt, question_batch_prompt`). Every `app/` module reads time through the module (`from app import clock` → `clock.utc_now_iso()`, including `app/ai/content.py` for `Question.created_at`), never `from app.clock import ...` (§1). §13 lists the `app.main` and `app.api.parent` names.

`app/ai/llm.py` (Task 8):
```python
RETRY_DELAYS_S = (1.0, 2.0)
class LLMError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message: str = "") -> None     # message passes through redact() (all subclasses)
class TransientError(LLMError): ...
class InvalidOutput(LLMError): ...                  # unparseable JSON, finish_reason == "length", malformed envelope, schema mismatch
class RateLimited(LLMError):
    def __init__(self, message: str, retry_after: float | None = None, daily: bool = False)   # attrs .retry_after, .daily
class DailyCapReached(LLMError): ...                # raised by the on_request callback when AI_DAILY_CALL_LIMIT is hit
@dataclass
class LLMResult: data: dict; usage: dict; finish_reason: str
class LLMClient(Protocol):
    async def chat_json(self, *, name: str, schema: dict, system: str, user: str) -> LLMResult
async def _sleep(seconds: float) -> None             # module-level; tests monkeypatch app.ai.llm._sleep
class CerebrasClient:
    def __init__(self, *, api_key: str, model: str, base_url: str, max_completion_tokens: int, timeout_s: float,
                 on_request: Callable[[], None] | None = None, transport: httpx.AsyncBaseTransport | None = None)
    model: str
    async def chat_json(self, *, name, schema, system, user) -> LLMResult
        # POST {base_url}/chat/completions with {"model", "messages":[system,user], "max_completion_tokens",
        #  "response_format": {"type":"json_schema","json_schema":{"name": name, "strict": True, "schema": schema}}}
        # Authorization: Bearer key. Before EVERY HTTP attempt: `await asyncio.to_thread(on_request)` (the production hook
        # is a blocking SQLite write; whatever it raises, e.g. DailyCapReached, propagates and no request is sent).
        # Retries transport errors and 5xx up to 2 times (_sleep 1s, 2s) then TransientError("LLM request failed after
        # 3 attempts: ..."). 429 → RateLimited(retry_after = float "retry-after" header (bad → None, negative → 0.0),
        # daily = header "x-ratelimit-remaining-requests-day" == "0" or "day" in body.lower()). Other 4xx → LLMError
        # ("HTTP <code>: <≤300 chars>"). finish_reason "length", empty/non-JSON/non-object content → InvalidOutput.
        # usage = response "usage" object or {}. Exceptions raised with `from None`.
    async def aclose(self) -> None
```
`tests/fakes.py` (Task 8 appends): `class FakeLLM` implementing `chat_json`; `model = "fake-llm"`; `FakeLLM(script: dict[str, list[dict | BaseException | type[BaseException] | Callable[[str, str], dict]]] | None = None)` keyed by schema `name`; each call pops the next item (dict → `LLMResult(data=deepcopy(item), usage={"completion_tokens": 10}, finish_reason="stop")`; exception instance or class → raised; callable → called with `(system, user)` and must return a dict). Records `calls: list[dict]` (`{"name","system","user"}`). Extras: `add(name, *items)`, `calls_for(name) -> list[dict]`. Raises `AssertionError` if a name's script is exhausted/unknown or a callable returns a non-dict.

### 10. Images (Task 12)

```python
# app/ai/images/base.py
class ImageProvider(ABC):
    name: str = "base"
    @abstractmethod
    async def generate(self, prompt: str) -> bytes      # raw image bytes (any Pillow format); raise on failure
    async def aclose(self) -> None                      # concrete no-op default; providers with network clients override
# app/ai/images/openai_compatible.py — the chosen provider is z.ai (base_url https://api.z.ai/api/paas/v4,
# models "glm-image" / "cogview-4-250304"); the class keeps the OpenAI Images shape, so other compatible APIs work too
DEFAULT_SIZE = "1024x1024"; MAX_IMAGE_MB = 20; MAX_IMAGE_BYTES = MAX_IMAGE_MB * 1024 * 1024
class OpenAICompatibleImageProvider(ImageProvider):     # name = "openai_compatible"; attributes model, base_url (trailing /
                                                        # stripped), size, quality (both whitespace-stripped)
    def __init__(self, *, api_key: str, model: str, base_url: str, size: str = "1024x1024", quality: str = "",
                 timeout_s: float = 120.0, on_request: Callable[[], None] | None = None,
                 transport: httpx.AsyncBaseTransport | None = None)
    async def generate(self, prompt: str) -> bytes
        # `await asyncio.to_thread(on_request)` once (what it raises propagates; no request sent), then
        # POST {base_url}/images/generations with Authorization: Bearer key and a body of EXACTLY {"model","prompt","size"}
        # plus "quality" only when quality is non-empty — NO "n" (not in z.ai's API; OpenAI/Together default to 1) and
        # NO "response_format" (OpenAI gpt-image models reject it). Extra response fields (z.ai "created",
        # "content_filter") are ignored. data[0].b64_json present → base64-decode it; otherwise data[0].url (http/https
        # only; z.ai's link expires after 30 days, so it is fetched at once) → streamed GET with the same httpx client,
        # follow_redirects=True, no Authorization header, not counted by on_request; neither → LLMError. A picture over
        # MAX_IMAGE_BYTES → LLMError ("... larger than 20 MB"): a Content-Length over the cap is refused before reading,
        # an undeclared body stops being read once past the cap, a decoded b64_json is checked after decoding.
        # Status mapping for both requests: 429 → RateLimited(retry_after from "retry-after"), 5xx/transport →
        # TransientError, other 4xx / malformed payload / bad base64 / a download that ends non-2xx (e.g. 3xx without
        # Location) / empty download → LLMError; messages redacted (≤ 300 chars of the body); no retries inside
        # generate (the worker retries).
    async def aclose(self) -> None                      # closes the httpx.AsyncClient
# app/ai/images/__init__.py — NO default base URL (no DEFAULT_OPENAI_BASE_URL): an implicit https://api.openai.com/v1
# would send a z.ai key to OpenAI when IMAGE_BASE_URL is forgotten
REQUIRED_SETTINGS: tuple[tuple[str, str], ...]          # (field, message) in this order; messages EXACTLY:
    # "IMAGE_BASE_URL is required when IMAGE_PROVIDER=openai_compatible (for z.ai use https://api.z.ai/api/paas/v4)"
    # "IMAGE_API_KEY is required when IMAGE_PROVIDER=openai_compatible (create a z.ai key at https://z.ai/manage-apikey/apikey-list and put it in .env)"
    # "IMAGE_MODEL is required when IMAGE_PROVIDER=openai_compatible (for z.ai use glm-image or cogview-4-250304)"
def make_image_provider(settings: Settings, on_request: Callable[[], None] | None = None) -> ImageProvider | None
    # kind = (image_provider or "").strip().lower() or "none": "none", empty or whitespace-only → None;
    # "openai_compatible" → every REQUIRED_SETTINGS field that is blank (after strip) is reported in ONE
    # ValueError("; ".join(messages)) — so only IMAGE_BASE_URL missing gives exactly the first message; otherwise the
    # provider (base_url = image_base_url.strip(), model = image_model.strip(), api_key = image_api_key as given,
    # size = image_size, quality = image_quality, default timeout); anything else →
    # ValueError("Unknown IMAGE_PROVIDER '<value>' (use 'none' or 'openai_compatible')"). create_app (§13) catches
    # these ValueErrors and runs with pictures off.
# app/ai/images/process.py
STYLE_PREAMBLE: str                                     # contains "flat cartoon", "no text or letters", "kid-safe"
def build_image_prompt(scene: str) -> str               # f"{STYLE_PREAMBLE} Scene: {whitespace-collapsed scene}"
def to_webp(data: bytes, max_edge: int = 768) -> bytes  # EXIF transpose, keep RGBA if alpha else RGB, LANCZOS shrink only,
                                                        # WebP quality 82 method 4; non-images raise OSError
def image_key(band: str, word: str, version: int) -> str      # "images/{band}/{slug}-v{version}.webp"
```

```python
RATE_LIMIT_DEFAULT_S = 60; NO_GENERATOR_DEFER_S = 3600; IDLE_S = 1.0; TOPUP_MAX = 6; ERROR_MAX_CHARS = 500
AI_KINDS = frozenset({"learn", "questions", "topup"})
class StaleJob(Exception); class PoolShortfall(Exception)
def next_utc_midnight(now: datetime) -> datetime
def job_mode(content: WordContent | None, job: Job) -> str | None    # "first" | "draft" | "active" (image/topup) | None (stale)
class Worker:
    def __init__(self, *, repo: Repository, blobs: BlobStore, generator: ContentGenerator | None,
                 image_provider: ImageProvider | None, settings: Settings, now_fn: Callable[[], datetime] = clock.utc_now)
    repo, blobs, generator, image_provider, settings, now_fn, paused: bool     # public, assignable
    @property in_flight -> int                          # jobs currently inside run_one()
    async def run_one(self) -> bool       # False when paused or nothing claimable; else claim (repo calls via asyncio.to_thread),
                                          # process, finish/fail/defer with the claim's lease_token; True.
                                          # Counts itself in in_flight right after the paused check, with no await in

    async def run(self, stop: asyncio.Event) -> None    # max(1, gen_concurrency) loops; idle wait IDLE_S on `stop`
    def make_on_request(self) -> Callable[[], None]     # incr_ai_calls(utc_date(now_fn())); raise DailyCapReached when count > limit
    async def pause_and_drain(self, timeout: float = 30.0) -> bool
        # sets paused, then waits (asyncio.Event created lazily in the running loop, set when in_flight drops to 0)
        # until no job is being processed; False on timeout (stays paused)
    def resume(self) -> None                            # paused = False
```
Behavior per spec §7.1–7.2 with `Job.chain` (list): first-time = `content.content_version == job.target_version and content.status != "ready"`; draft = `content.draft_version == job.target_version`; image/topup need `content_version == target_version`; otherwise stale → finish_job and discard. Version guard re-checked after every model call. Success enqueues `chain[0]` with `chain[1:]` before finishing. `topup` targets the active version, adds verified questions without exceeding POOL_CAP; finishing with 0 added is still `done`. `image` with no provider or no card → `set_image(None, "none")` and finish; empty `image_scene` → `"a simple scene that shows the idea: <short_def>"`. Errors: every exception other than RateLimited/DailyCapReached consumes an attempt (stored text `redact(f"{ExceptionClass}: {message}")[:500]`): retry with BACKOFF_S or final; RateLimited → defer_job (retry_after or 60s; daily → next UTC midnight); DailyCapReached → defer to next UTC midnight; daily-limit pre-check (`get_ai_calls(today) >= limit`) defers AI jobs (and image jobs with a provider) without a model call. Final failure by kind (only when the final `fail_job` returned True): first-time → content failed + error; draft → `error = "Regeneration failed: …"`, draft cleared, current version keeps serving; image → `image_status = "failed"` (image_key kept); topup → job only. Generator None → learn/questions/topup jobs are deferred NO_GENERATOR_DEFER_S without an attempt; image jobs still run. **Ownership:** because finish/fail/defer carry the lease token, a Regenerate (newer enqueue) made while a job runs, or a re-claim after an expired lease, is never overwritten by the old worker.

`app/seed_legacy.py`: `STARTER_LIST_NAME = "Starter set"`, `LEGACY_BAND = "6-8"`, `LEGACY_VERSION = 1`, `DEFAULT_LEGACY_PATH = <repo>/legacy/index.html`; `def seed_legacy(repo: Repository, blobs: BlobStore, legacy_path: Path) -> int` (returns words seeded; no-op returning 0 if a list named "Starter set" exists) and `def main() -> None` (CLI `python -m app.seed_legacy`, prints `Seeded <n> legacy starter words into <data_dir>`). Auto-run on first start (Task 16) when `repo.list_lists()` is empty and the legacy file exists.

```python
ROOT; WEB_DIR = ROOT / "web"; LEGACY_PATH = ROOT / "legacy" / "index.html"; WORKER_STOP_TIMEOUT_S = 5.0
MEDIA_TYPES = {".webp": "image/webp", ".png": "image/png", ".jpg": "image/jpeg", ".jpeg": "image/jpeg"}; MEDIA_DIR = "images"
class OpenAccessWarning:   # ASGI middleware(app, settings); attribute warned; logs once on logger "wordquest" when a

    # no filesystem side effects at call time. Lifespan: settings.ensure_dirs();
```

**Names tests monkeypatch in `app.main`:** `CerebrasClient`, `make_image_provider`, `make_storage` and `seed_legacy` are imported by name (`from app.ai.llm import CerebrasClient, LLMClient`, `from app.ai.images import make_image_provider`, `from app.storage import make_storage`, `from app.seed_legacy import seed_legacy`) and looked up as module globals when the lifespan runs (never captured at import time or in `create_app`'s defaults), because tests replace `app.main.CerebrasClient`, `app.main.make_image_provider`, `app.main.make_storage` and `app.main.seed_legacy`. Likewise `app.api.parent` imports `import_backup` by name (`from app.backup import import_backup`) and calls the module global inside `POST /import` (tests replace `app.api.parent.import_backup`). Tests also patch `app.jobs.Worker.run` on the class, which works however `Worker` is imported. (§9 lists the AI-layer names.)
`app/api/learner.py` — `router = APIRouter(prefix="/api", dependencies=[Depends(require_site)])`; `DATE_PATTERN = r"^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$"`, `KEEP_PRACTICING_MAX = 5`, `MAX_EVENTS_PER_UPLOAD = 500`; bodies `SessionStart(mode: "normal"|"practice" = "normal", local_date)`, `EventsUpload(events: list[EventIn] ≤ 500)`, `FinishBody(active_minutes: int = 0, 0–600)`; public helper `eligible_words(repo, profile) -> list[str]` (words of `profile.list_ids` in list order then word order, first occurrence wins, missing lists skipped):
- `GET /profiles` → `[{"id","name","avatar"}]`.
- `GET /profiles/{id}/home?local_date=` → `{"profile": {"id","name","avatar","band","session_minutes","new_words_per_session"}, "mastered","learning","new","due_today","ready_new","practice_eligible","preparing": {"ready","total"}}`.
- `POST /profiles/{id}/sessions` `{"mode","local_date"}` → `build_session` payload + `"session_id"` (seed = `int(sha256(session_id).hexdigest()[:16], 16)`); each `words[w]` carries `"image_url"` (= `blobs.url_for(image_key)` only when `image_status == "ready"`, else null) instead of `"image_key"`; empty queue → no Session saved and `"session_id": null`; otherwise `Session.words` = unique queue words, `planned_minutes = profile.settings.session_minutes`; then `maybe_enqueue_topup(..., clock.utc_date())` for `topup_words(inp)`.
- `POST /sessions/{sid}/events` `{"events": [EventIn...]}` → `{"accepted": [...]}` via `repo.apply_events(sid, [AnswerEvent(session_id=sid, profile_id=session.profile_id, ...)], apply_events_to_state)`.
- `POST /sessions/{sid}/finish` `{"active_minutes"}` → `{"accuracy" (int %), "answered", "new_words", "stars_up", "keep_practicing": [{"word","stage"}] (≤5), "break_reminder", "break_message"}`; `finished_at` set only the first time.
- Errors: 404 `profile_not_found` / `session_not_found`, 422 for malformed input, 401 from the gate.

`app/learning/stats.py`: `WINDOW_DAYS = 30`, `WEAKEST_LIMIT = 12`, `RECENT_SESSIONS_LIMIT = 10`, `GRADED_KINDS = ("answer", "unsure")`, `window_start(today) -> str` (= `add_days(today, -29)`), `profile_stats(profile: Profile, progress: list[WordProgress], sessions: list[Session], events: list[AnswerEvent], today: str, eligible_words: list[str]) -> dict` → `{"profile": {"id","name","avatar","band"}, "today", "window_start", "counts": {"mastered","learning","new","due_today","total"}, "accuracy": {"overall","answered","correct","by_type": {qtype: {"answered","correct","accuracy"}}}, "unsure_rate", "days_practiced_30", "weakest": [{"word","stage","wrong","unsure","misses","seen","due_date"}], "recent_sessions": [{"id","local_date","mode","minutes","answered","correct","unsure","accuracy","finished"}]}` (ratios 0–1 rounded to 3 places or null).

`app/backup.py`: `BACKUP_FORMAT`, `BACKUP_VERSION`, `COLLECTIONS`; `def import_backup(repo: Repository, blobs: BlobStore, data: dict) -> dict` — checks the shape (ValueError), `repo.import_all(data)`, then for every content whose `image_key` blob is missing → `set_image(None, "none")`; a key that cannot be looked up counts as missing (`_blob_exists` catches `ValueError` — `LocalBlobStore` refuses e.g. `"../x"` — and `OSError` — e.g. `ENAMETOOLONG` for a 5,000-character key), so a crafted backup never aborts the import after `import_all`; drops orphaned drafts (`draft`/`draft_version` → None); `ensure_generation` for every pending/failed content; returns `{"profiles","lists","contents","questions","progress","sessions","events","images_missing","jobs_requeued"}` (ints). The caller pauses and drains the worker.

`app/api/parent.py` — `router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/parent", dependencies=[Depends(require_site), Depends(require_parent)])`; constants `JOB_KINDS`, `STATS_SESSION_LIMIT = 1000`, `NOT_ASSIGNED_NOTE`, `IMPORT_DRAIN_TIMEOUT_S = 30.0`; bodies `ProfileCreate`, `ProfilePatch`, `ProfileListsIn`, `ListCreate`, `ListPatch`, `RegenerateIn`. All successes are 200:
- `GET /profiles` → `[Profile]`; `POST /profiles` `{"name","band","avatar"?,"settings"?,"list_ids"?}` → `Profile` (400 `"unknown list ids: …"`, 422 invalid); `PATCH /profiles/{id}` `{"name"?,"avatar"?,"band"?,"settings"? (partial, merged)}` → `Profile` (404 `profile_not_found`, 422 `"invalid settings: …"`); `DELETE /profiles/{id}` → `{"ok": true}`; `PUT /profiles/{id}/lists` `{"list_ids"}` → `Profile` (deduped, order kept); `GET /profiles/{id}/stats?local_date=` → `profile_stats(...)` (400 `invalid local_date`).
- `GET /lists` → `[ListSummary]` (`WordList` fields + `"word_count"`, `"ready_count"`, `"bands"`, `"profile_ids"`); `POST /lists` `{"name","words": str | [str],"assign_profile_ids"}` → `{"list": ListSummary, "rejected": [{"entry","reason"}]}` (400 `"unknown profile ids: …"`, nothing saved); `PATCH /lists/{id}` `{"name"?,"add_words"?,"remove_words"?,"assign_profile_ids"?}` → same shape (remove before add; past 600 → `"list is full (600 max)"`; `assign_profile_ids` replaces the holder set; `on_lists_changed` when words were added or assignment sent; 404 `list_not_found`); `DELETE /lists/{id}` → `{"ok": true}`.
- `GET /content?list_id=&band=` → `{"list_id","bands","items": [{"word","band","status" ("pending"|"ready"|"failed"|"missing"),"image_status","pool_size","error","image_error","regenerating","source","content_version"}],"note"}` (400 `unknown_band`; `image_error` = `redact(get_job("image:{band}:{word}").last_error)` while `image_status == "failed"`, `""` otherwise or when that job is gone — a Regenerate/Retry of the picture re-enqueues the job, which clears it); `GET /content/{band}/{word}` → `{"content": WordContent, "image_url": str | null, "image_error": str, "pool": [Question]}` (same `image_error`, for Preview; 404 `content_not_found`); `POST /content/{band}/{word}/regenerate` `{"part"}` → content row (400 ValueError text).
- `GET /queue` → `{"counts": {...}, "ai_calls_today", "ai_daily_limit", "deferred_to_tomorrow"}`; `GET /status` → `{"ai_enabled","model","image_provider","image_model","image_config_error","parent_enabled"}` (`image_model` = the provider's `model`, `""` without a provider; `image_config_error` = `redact(app.state.image_config_error)`, `""` when the image settings are fine — with bad settings `image_provider` is `"none"`; never key values); `GET /export` → backup JSON with `Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="wordquest-backup-YYYY-MM-DD.json"`.
- `POST /import` (async) multipart `file` + form `confirm=true` → `{"ok": true, "counts": {...}}`; 400 `confirm_required` | `invalid_json` | `"invalid_backup: …"`; before importing it calls `await worker.pause_and_drain(IMPORT_DRAIN_TIMEOUT_S)` — on timeout `worker.resume()` and 503 `{"detail": "busy"}` (nothing imported); `import_backup` runs via `asyncio.to_thread`; `worker.resume()` in a `finally`. Error `detail`s pass through `redact()`.

`tests/test_security_leaks.py` (Task 19): sentinel secrets through the real clients (`httpx.MockTransport`), worker failures, every GET route, stored errors, job errors, export and every file under DATA_DIR; every `/api/*` route except `POST /api/auth/site` answers 401 `access_code_required` without the site cookie.

Events pushed by the session screens carry every `EventIn` field and use the session payload's `local_date`. CSS carries over legacy classes (.wrap .hero .card .btn .btn-primary .btn-secondary .btn-ghost .btn-opt .correct .wrong .btn-learn .chips .chip .topbar .timer .pbar .qtype .qprompt .blank .feedback .typebox .learn-img .learn-word .learn-pos .learn-def .parts .ex .synchips .syn .stars .stat-grid .stat .toast .eyebreak .tile-fallback) plus the Task 20 additions and the `p`-prefixed Parent-area block (Task 22, incl. `.pimgerr`: the small red failed-picture reason under the "🖼 failed" badge and in Preview; the Status & backup panel shows `image_config_error` as a `.perr` line under Pictures). Every tap target is at least 44 px (spec §10; Task 20's `test_tap_targets_are_at_least_44px`): `.btn`/`.btn-opt`/`.speak`/`.profile-tile`/type-in box 48 px, `.ex .speak` 44 × 44 px, `a.parent-link`, `.row-actions .btn` and `.tab` min-height 44 px, and the Parent-area controls (`.pbtn`, `.ptab`, `.plink`, `.pregen`, `.pcheck`, `.porder button`) 44 px. Model text reaches the DOM only through `esc()` or text nodes. Pictures are same-origin `/media/images/…` URLs (site-gated; the `wq_site` cookie is sent automatically).
